snippet.title: Sega Saturn - Suchie-Pai Adventure - Doki Doki Nightmare (1998)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Suchie-Pai Adventure: Doki Doki Nightmare is an Adventure game, developed and published by Jaleco Entertainment, which was released in Japan in 1998.
